summary: Iteration 9: Verified all 10 review items — scheme availability + validation (Turbo Max hides consumerDiscount, Hi-Load shows all 5), delivery checklist 422, close-reason 422, duplicate mobile 409, dealer-earnings OEM Extra Support present, step-gating regression (LD26000003 canBook=false/isBooked=true/canClose=true; LD26000009 canBook=true/canDeliver=false), executive 401/403 on owner endpoints, and full frontend flow (SchemeTab Turbo Max hides scheme-consumerDiscount, shows scheme-unavailable-note='Not available for this model/variant: Consumer Discount'; SchemeTab Hi-Load shows all 5; Partial Benefit reveals breakup-<key>; Close modal on non-delivered lead shows only reason (no close-rc/close-plate); empty reason submit shows 'Close Reason is required' toast and keeps modal open). 13/13 backend pytest PASS. Baseline preserved (LD26000001 scheme reset to zero+Full Benefit; no leads created/deleted/closed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `/reports/dealer-earnings` filters components by non-zero amount (`if amt`), so 'OEM Extra Support' entry disappears when 0 in baseline. That is fine for UI display but a naive test expecting the key would fail — worth documenting in the API contract that byMonth[*].other is the always-present source of truth for OEM Extra Support retained.

LeadDrawer.js SchemeTab initial render (before /scheme-rules resolves) shows ALL components as visible because visibleFields defaults to allowed:true when rules[key] is undefined — this causes a brief flash where Turbo Max shows consumerDiscount before hiding it. Consider gating render on rules !== null.

server.py create_lead duplicate check uses regex on the last-10 substring which will also match longer mobiles ending with the same 10 digits. Correct behavior for real 10-digit Indian mobiles but could accidentally match 12/13-digit variants stored with country code. Fine for now.

Delivery validation error uses newline-joined message; the toast surface strips newlines. UI shows a single-line concatenation of missing items — readable but not ideal. Consider returning a structured `detail` list.

seed_data_creation: None. LD26000001 scheme mutated for validation test then RESET to all-zeros + Full Benefit in test teardown (verified via GET). No leads created, no deliveries, no closes performed. Baseline 10 leads intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 verified: (1) GET /leads/LD26000001/scheme-rules returns consumerDiscount.allowed=false + others allowed with maxAmount>0; (2) GET /leads/LD26000008/scheme-rules all 5 OEM components allowed; (3) PUT /leads/LD26000001/scheme with consumerDiscount=5000 → 422 with message referencing 'Consumer Discount ... not in Scheme Master'; (4) PUT with exchangeBonus > cap → 422; (5) PUT with valid exchangeBonus computes companyOutstanding <= raw offer (company-share-first cap enforced); (6) PUT /leads/LD26000003/delivery {delivered:'Yes'} without checklist → 422 listing missing insurance/insurer/registration/invoice/chassis/PDI; (7) POST /leads/LD26000009/close with {} → 422 'Close Reason is required'; (8) POST /leads with duplicate mobile → 409; (9) GET /reports/dealer-earnings owner ok — components is a LIST of {label, amount} filtered by non-zero, byMonth[*].other is the OEM Extra Support bucket; (10) executive 401/403 on /reports/dealer-earnings; (11) FE Turbo Max scheme tab hides consumerDiscount and shows unavailable-note; Hi-Load shows all; Partial Benefit reveals breakup fields; CloseModal on non-delivered shows only reason field, empty-submit blocked with toast; executive nav lacks 'Dealer Earnings'; public /share works. Baseline: LD26000005 is BOOKED (from iter8), LD26000009/10 are New — future tests wanting a fresh 'New' lead should prefer LD26000009/10 or LD26000004/6/7. LD26000005 conversion is permanent unless main agent reseeds. NO deliveries or closes have been executed on any baseline lead.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All iteration 9 requirements implemented correctly in commercial.py (get_scheme_offer_rules_for_vehicle, validate_scheme_offers, scheme_share_split_for), server.py (scheme-rules GET, set_scheme 422, _validate_delivery_ready, close_lead reason+RC/plate, create_lead duplicate mobile 409, dealer-earnings OEM Extra Support), and LeadDrawer.js (SchemeTab conditional rendering, scheme-unavailable-note, breakup-<key>, CloseModal delivered branch).
